title.id: Undang-Undang tentang pemberian wewenang kepada Dewan Provinsi untuk menghadirkan saksi dan mewajibkan kesaksian di bawah sumpah dalam pelaksanaan penyelidikan tertentu
title.ms: Akta bagi memberi kuasa kepada Majlis Wilayah untuk menghadirkan saksi dan mensyaratkan kesaksian di bawah sumpah dalam menjalankan siasatan tertentu

text.en:
In all investigations conducted under the provisions of Act Numbered Three hundred and
fourteen, entitled "An Act amending the Provincial Government Act so as to provide a more simple method
of procedure in cases of suspended municipal officials and justices of the peace," the provincial board is
hereby empowered in require by subpoena the presence of the accused officer and the attendance and
testimony under oath of witnesses, as also the production of all records, books, papers, and documents
relating to the matter under investigation, and to that end and for that purpose shall have power to enforce
attendance of witnesses and require them to testify, and to maintain order, in the same manner and to the
same extent as justices of the peace are required to do by Act Numbered One hundred and ninety.

In all cases where the Civil Governor shall remove any municipal officer or justice of the peace
from office, he is hereby empowered, in his discretion, to declare such official disqualified thereafter from
holding office. Such disqualification may be either special or general, and either temporary or permanent.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, April 28, 1904.
